description: This file implements a stock alerts service for a web application, providing functions for subscribing, unsubscribing, checking subscriptions, and handling notifications for product restocks, with fallback to localStorage and optional backend API integration.

methods.name: readSubs
methods.description: Reads the set of product subscriptions from localStorage.

methods.name: writeSubs
methods.description: Persists the set of product subscriptions to localStorage.

methods.name: detectBackendAvailable
methods.description: Checks if backend stock endpoints are available, with caching.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Registers interest in a product's restock, using backend if available, otherwise localStorage.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes interest in a product's restock, using backend if available, otherwise localStorage.

methods.name: isSubscribed
methods.description: Checks if a product is currently subscribed locally.

methods.name: pushBanner
methods.description: Adds a banner message to the local storage queue.

methods.name: popNextBanner
methods.description: Retrieves and removes the next banner message from the queue.

methods.name: notifyIfRestocked
methods.description: Sends a notification and banner if a product has been restocked and is subscribed.

methods.name: getAllLocalSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns a list of all locally stored product subscriptions.
